predictions.rationale: Central MVC controller that directly implements user login, logout, registration, and related account flows, mapping exactly to the requested feature.
Configures ASP-NET Identity and IdentityServer, setting up token issuance, authentication middleware, and protection for downstream services.
Declares IdentityServer4 resources, scopes, and clients, defining how access tokens are produced and validated.
Service that verifies user credentials against the EF store and issues authentication results used by token generation.
Supplies user claims to IdentityServer when creating JWT access tokens, directly supporting protected resource access.
Entity Framework context housing ApplicationUser and related identity tables, foundational for user registration and management.
Interface for login operations leveraged by controllers and services to authenticate users and issue tokens.
Delegating handler that attaches bearer tokens to outbound gateway HTTP calls, enforcing protected-service access.
Adds the authenticated user's access token to outgoing requests from the MVC front-end, ensuring token-protected communication.
Represents the user entity within Identity, holding credentials and profile data used during authentication and token issuance.
